1.explanation: The restriction on copying boundary events is enforced by the rules system, specifically by the BpmnRules class, which provides BPMN-specific modeling rules. The canCopy function is the rule-checking function determining whether an element (such as a boundary event) can be copied. The bug is directly related to logic within canCopy, which enforces or restricts copying based on element type. To fix the bug, adjustments must be made in BpmnRules (and particularly in canCopy) to allow the copying of boundary events. No changes are needed in the copy-paste implementation itself (lib/features/copy-paste/BpmnCopyPaste.js) because the prevention is at the rule-checking layer.
